request.text: My dog keeps digging in the newly planted bed. Give me a gentle plan to protect the seedlings without frightening him.

responsibilities.outcome: Offer humane, practical guidance for protecting the new seedlings from the dog's digging without frightening the dog.

new_goals.description: Help the user protect newly planted seedlings from the dog's digging through gentle, non-frightening measures.
new_goals.source_text: My dog keeps digging in the newly planted bed. Give me a gentle plan to protect the seedlings without frightening him.
constraints: Prefer humane barriers, redirection, supervision, and reinforcement over frightening or punitive measures.

success_criteria: The user receives a practical, humane sequence for protecting the bed and redirecting the dog.

semantic_facts: The scoped advice Goal remains answerable directly despite the Situation revision and should not be converted into embodied Work.
